d:
Trakar tobiyas vagnar ka mishan hai - jarmani ke eest friziya se ilektrik trak men norve jana. uttari sagar ke “yuistar rif” ki nevigeshan boy bahkar skaindineviya pahunch gaee. ab is bhatki huee boy ko vapas jarmani lana tobiyas ka kam hai.
900 kilomitar, tin desh aur feri ka safar - sab kuchh ilektrik trak men. tobiyas ko soch-samajhkar rut plan karna parta hai. trak ka vazan, duri aur charhaee uski renj par asar dalte hain. rat bhar rukne ki sahi jagah chunna bhi zaruri hai, kyonki har trak parking men charjing steshan nahin hote.
